name: a_records
type:
map(object({
    name                = string
    resource_group_name = string
    zone_name           = string
    ttl                 = number
    records             = list(string)
    target_resource_id  = optional(string)
    tags                = optional(map(string), null)
  }))
description: A map of objects where each object contains information to create a A record.
